تقتلعن (form VIII)

# تُقْتَلَعْنَ (tuqtalaʕna) /tuq.ta.laʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
